def winfo(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
    return None
print("W now:",winfo(current_frame))

def sig(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if min(rs)==0 and max(rs)==0: continue
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return d
print("N now:",sig(current_frame).get('N'))
print("W now:",sig(current_frame).get('W'))

def winfo(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels'])
    return None

def sig(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        if min(rs)==0 and max(rs)==0: continue
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs),n['pixels']))
    return d
